text: dsh-weread 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的微信读书侧栏插件：宿主入口注册共享服务、书籍工具和 /api/weread 通道，浏览器端提供右侧阅读面板。用户可以查看并筛选书架、搜索书城、查看书籍目录和阅读正文，也可从上次位置继续阅读；本地与云端进度按更新时间合并。面板支持二维码或 Cookie 登录，未登录时可浏览演示书。若启用进度回写，阅读进度和时长会同步到微信读书；插件不需要单独的 DSH 密钥，使用 Agent Gateway 时需要微信读书 API Key。

dsh-weread adds a WeRead shelf and chapter reader to DSH's Web sidebar. Browse or search books, inspect chapters, and resume from merged local and cloud progress. Sign in by QR or Cookie, or try a demo book. Optional progress write-back uses WeRead; its Agent Gateway requires a WeRead API Key.
想在 DSH 右侧栏打开微信读书书架，看看最近读到哪本书。
能不能在 DSH 里搜微信读书的书名，再直接看章节目录？
I want to read a WeRead chapter in a sidebar inside DSH.
dsh-weread 的功能「侧栏书架与书城搜索」：在 DSH Web 右侧面板查看书架、筛选阅读状态并搜索书籍；面板和 Agent 工具共用服务，搜索结果可用于打开书籍详情。
dsh-weread 的功能「章节阅读与续读」：选择书籍后查看目录并读取章节正文；本地记住的阅读位置会与微信读书云端进度按更新时间合并，重新打开时可从对应章节继续。
dsh-weread 会向微信读书发送登录 Cookie 与书架、搜索和章节请求；启用回写时也会提交进度和时长。Cookie 保存在本机。Agent Gateway 需配置微信读书 API Key。
dsh-weread 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 9 天；提交数 5；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

WeChat Reading (WeRead) right-sidebar bookshelf and chapter reader for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

dsh-weread README · Features：- Right-sidebar panel: bookshelf, store search, prominent Continue card
- Shelf filters (All / Reading / Finished) with progress and reading-time labels
- Cover-first bookshelf, with a list view toggle
- Merges local vs cloud progress by recency; syncs progress and reading time back to WeRead
- Sign in with WeChat QR or Cookie; expired sessions offer a one-tap re-login
- Reader dock with chapter progress and TOC; ←→ / Space / side-click paging
- Demo book when signed out
- Agent tools (registered when the names are free): `weread_shelf`, `weread_search`, `weread_book`, `weread_chapter`

dsh-weread README · Features：> If [weread-export](https://github.com/zhengjy01/weread-export) is already installed, some tool names may already be taken; this plugin still serves the sidebar UI and `/api/weread`.

dsh-weread README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add wwjzzy/dsh-weread
```

Or install from a local path / npm once published.

Restart Harness after install, then open the **WeRead** tab in the right sidebar.

dsh-weread README · Config：Optional Cordis config (also editable in the panel):

```yaml
cookie: ''            # weread.qq.com Cookie header; leave empty to use QR login or demo mode
syncProgress: false   # write chapter progress and reading time back to WeRead
```

Turn on **进度回写** in Settings to sync while you read. Reports use the same signed `POST /web/book/read` body as the official web reader, with idle detection so an open tab is not counted as reading time.
